'''Joël François Mesot''' (born 31 August 1964) is a Swiss [[physicist]] and academic. He is currently the [[President (education)|President]] of the [[Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich]], also known as [[ETH Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www2.unil.ch/elitessuisses/index.php?page=detailPerso&idIdentite=82847 |title=''Mesot, Joël (1964 - )'' Base de données des élites suisses |publisher=University of Lausanne |access-date=29 December 2020}}</ref>

==Biography==
Mesot was born in [[Geneva]], Switzerland, where he grew up. He studied physics at the [[ETH Zurich]] from 1984 to 1989, followed by doctoral studies at the same university as well as at the [[Institut Laue-Langevin]], [[Grenoble]] in France. In 1992, he was awarded a PhD in physics (Dr. sc. nat.) from the ETH Zurich with a thesis on high-temperature superconductors supervised by Albert Furrer.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.research-collection.ethz.ch/handle/20.500.11850/140891?locale-attribute=en |title=Etude par diffusion neutronique de l'action du champ cristallin sur l'ion Er³⁺ dans les systèmes supraconducteurs à haute température critique |publisher=ETH Zurich|author=Joël Mesot |date=1992|access-date=29 December 2020}}</ref> Thereafter he joined the [[Paul Scherrer Institute]] (PSI) as a researcher in the field of [[neutron scattering]]. He continued his research at the [[Argonne National Laboratory]] in [[Chicago]] to perform angle-resolved photoemission [[spectroscopy]] (ARPES) experiments. In 1999, he returned to the PSI, where he was responsible for the laboratory investigating neutron scattering. He became chair of the PSI Research Commission in 2007. In August 2008, he was promoted to head the entire operations at PSI as its director. At the same time, he was named full professor at the ETH Zurich as well as at the [[EPF Lausanne]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ethz.ch/services/en/organisation/who-is-who/phys/details.Mzc5NDU=.TGlzdC8xOTE4LDE1NDAwMTg0MDg=.html |title=''Mesot, Joël, Prof. Dr.: Curriculum Vitae.'' |publisher=ETH Zurich|access-date=28 December 2020}}</ref> He is a member of the ''[[ETH Board]],'' also  known as the [[Board of the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology]], since 2010.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ethrat.ch/en/eth-rat-mitglied-eth-rat/prof-dr-joel-mesot|title=''Members of ETH Board-'' |publisher=ETH Rat| author= |access-date=28 December 2020}}</ref> Mesot is a trustee of the [[Marcel Benoist Prize]] committee.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://marcel-benoist.ch/en/die-stiftung-en/board-of-trustees/ |title=''Board of Trustees.'' |publisher=Marcel Benoist Foundation |access-date=29 December 2020 |archive-date=22 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422172656/https://marcel-benoist.ch/en/die-stiftung-en/board-of-trustees/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Since January 2019, he is President of the ETH Zurich and, in 2022, was confirmed for a second term by the [[Federal Council (Switzerland)|Swiss Federal Council]] (2023–2026).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nzz.ch/meinung/der-neue-eth-praesident-joel-mesot-hat-einen-der-schwierigsten-jobs-der-schweiz-angetreten-ld.1445844 |title=''Der neue ETH-Präsident Joël Mesot hat einen der schwierigsten Jobs der Schweiz angetreten.''|publisher=Neue Zürcher Zeitung| author=Nils Pfändler |date=11 January 2019|access-date=28 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Federal Council selects new Empa director and confirms office of ETH Zurich president |url=https://www.admin.ch/gov/en/start/documentation/media-releases.msg-id-87320.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=www.admin.ch}}</ref> Mesot is the first President of the ETH Zurich coming from the French speaking part of Switzerland. He is fluent in French, German and English.

Mesot is vice chair of the board of trustees at the ETH Foundation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Foundation • ETH Zürich Foundation |url=https://ethz-foundation.ch/en/foundation/ |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zürich Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref> As president of the ETH Zurich, he is a member of [[Swissuniversities]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members - swissuniversities |url=https://www.swissuniversities.ch/en/organisation/members |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=www.swissuniversities.ch}}</ref> and the [[Swiss Innovation Park]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Switzerland Innovation |url=https://www.switzerland-innovation.com/about-us |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=Switzerland Innovation |language=en}}</ref>  In addition, he is part of international boards, such as the Governing Board of the Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise (CREATE) in Singapore.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise (CREATE) |url=https://www.nrf.gov.sg/programmes/create/ |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=nrf.gov.sg}}</ref>

Mesot is a member of the Executive Advisory Board of the [[World.minds|World.Minds]] Foundation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Team – WORLD.MINDS |url=https://www.worldminds.org/team/ |access-date=2025-05-15 |language=en}}</ref>

== Impact on ETH Zurich ==
As president, Mesot, alongside the other seven executive board members, is responsible for all legal and political matters of the ETH Zurich.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Executive Board |url=https://ethz.ch/en/the-eth-zurich/organisation/executive-board.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref> 

Mesot established "rETHink" as a means to improve the university from an organisational point of view. Furthermore, he strengthened the bonds between the ETH Zurich and the French-speaking part of Switzerland, for example by establishing a shared master programme "cyber security" of the ETH Zurich and its [[sister school]] the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPF Lausanne]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Master in Cyber Security |url=https://inf.ethz.ch/studies/master/master-cybsec.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref> Under his leadership, the new ETH AI Center<ref>{{Cite web |title=About Us |url=https://ai.ethz.ch/about-us.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref> and Centre for the Origin and Prevalence of Life (COPL)<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-09-25 |title=News |url=https://copl.ethz.ch/news.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref> were established in 2020 and 2022, respectively. In collaboration with the [[Dieter Schwarz Foundation]], an additional research center in [[Heilbronn]] and the establishment of 20 new professorships over the coming 30 years is planned.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Long-term partnership with the Dieter Schwarz Foundation • ETH Zürich Foundation |url=https://ethz-foundation.ch/en/spotlight/news-2023-dss-eth-zurich-donation-teaching-and-research-centre-in-germany/ |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zürich Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2023, Mesot established the "Coalition for Green Energy and Storage", a partnership between ETH Zurich, EPFL, and Swiss businesses to establish and produce new environment-friendly technologies.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-06-08 |title=ETH Zurich and EPFL launch a green energy coalition |url=https://ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/eth-news/news/2023/06/eth-zurich-and-epfl-launch-a-green-energy-coalition.html |access-date=2024-10-25 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 1995: IBM prize of the Swiss Physical Society (SPG) for ''Outstanding Work in Neutron Spectroscopic Studies of the Crystal Field in High-Tc Superconductors.''
* 2002: [[Latsis Foundation|Latsis prize]] of the ETH Zurich for his ''outstanding contribution to the investigation of high-temperature superconductors by neutron scattering and angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy.''<ref>''Présentation des Traveaux des quatres Lauréats.'' Fondation Latsis Internationale, No. 18, 2002</ref>

== Publications (Selection) ==
Mesot is author of over 250 published works and a book on strongly correlated materials.

* J. Mesot et al.: ''Neutron Spectroscopic Evidence for Cluster Formation and Percolative Superconductivity in ErBa2Cu3Ox.'' In: PRL 70 (1993), S. 865.

* A. Furrer, J. Mesot, T. Strässle: . In: . Band 04. World Scientific, 2009, ISBN 978-981-02-4830-7,  [[doi:10.1142/4870]].
* J. Chang, J. Mesot, et al.: . In: . Band 8, Nr. 12, Dezember 2012, S. 871–876, [[doi:10.1038/nphys2456]].
* B. Q. Lv, J. Mesot, et al.: . In: . Band 11, Nr. 9, September 2015, S. 724–727, [[doi:10.1038/nphys3426]].
